notes.title: Patch 1.05 is here with the new Freestyle game mode!
notes.notes:
We've added the new Freestyle game mode. Besides that, we updated levels 13, 74, and 107 so that now they can be solved by logical deduction only, no power-ups are needed.

Have fun and happy holidays!

If you enjoy the game, please leave a review!

Thank you for playing our game! :)

notes.title: New Language Support Added
notes.notes: Hello guys & gals! You can now play Daydream Mosaics in Czech, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (BR) and Spanish. We hope you'll enjoy it! ːsteamhappyː
